scope: Timeline, causality, and retry analysis for 7200s soak (b4_soak_stress_7200s, b4_soak_idle_7200s)

sanitization.verification: Only protocol opcodes, timings, and aggregated telemetry metrics included

concurrent_traffic.description: Incoming radar telemetry frame while PING is in flight

req_1099.root_cause_explanation: PING was issued at t=2798.704s during an active radar telemetry burst. The MCU prioritized UART RX/USB TX queue servicing, resulting in a single-attempt round-trip latency of 508.0ms. No packet loss or retry occurred. The historical judge failed because rebuild_judge_inputs_from_evidence did not preserve the resolved rtt_ms on the attempt record, causing the judge to measure against a hardcoded 500ms window ceiling and falsely flagging that the response arrived outside the attempt window.
req_1099.remediation: Updated rebuild_judge_inputs_from_evidence to record rtt_ms on matched attempts.

concurrent_traffic.description: 2x concurrent incoming radar telemetry frames arriving at the same millisecond timestamp

req_2652.root_cause_explanation: STATUS_GET was issued at t=6780.219s. Multiple telemetry frames were queued and delivered at t=6781.091s simultaneously with the STATUS_GET response (872.0ms latency). The single RPC succeeded cleanly on attempt 1 without timeout, retransmission, or CRC error. As with req 1099, the historical judge's attempt window lacked rtt_ms and defaulted to 500ms, creating an artificial 'resolved after attempt window' failure.
req_2652.remediation: Updated rebuild_judge_inputs_from_evidence to record rtt_ms on matched attempts.

60s_rehearsal.explanation: 60s dry run did not rigorously enforce offline network state validation.

7200s_soak.root_cause: The device was running a Wi-Fi enabled firmware image and remained associated with an AP (sta_ip valid). The idle soak specification strictly requires complete offline operation with unassociated radio state. The judge correctly failed this check.
7200s_soak.action_required: Flash nowifi profile (r60abd1-esp32c3-host-nowifi.yaml) or perform NVS Wi-Fi credentials erase before Batch 2 re-run.

60s_rehearsal.explanation: 60s rehearsal verified basic telemetry flow but did not require 5Hz LOG pressure.

7200s_soak.root_cause: Production firmware builds do not emit continuous 5Hz diagnostic log frames (MWCP_EVENT_LOG, 0x8002). The test suite's stress judge requires real 5Hz diagnostic log event pressure to validate bidirectional queue starvation prevention. In b4_soak_stress_7200s, zero log frames were received, triggering a legitimate fail.
7200s_soak.action_required: Flash diagnostic stress profile (r60abd1-stress-diag.yaml) providing controlled 5Hz log frames before Batch 2 re-run.

conclusion.historical_soak_status: REJECTED (Both 7200s idle and stress soak legitimately failed their gate checks)
conclusion.verdict: DO NOT rewrite soak results to pass. Retain historical runs as diagnostic; execute Batch 2 re-runs under authorized conditions with proper firmware profiles.
